## 
```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

##Importing new data
```{r}
here("data-raw/nurses-stress/stress/5C/5C_1586886626/HR.csv.gz") |>
  read_csv(
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    name_repair = "unique",
    n_max = 100
  )
```

## remember to use readr::read_csv()
